champion.tips: MEL TIPS AND TRICKS Whenever you can, try and use your Passive on the enemy ADC or squishy Support rather than using it on minions. This will give you a health advantage over the enemy. You need to fully understand what your W can block and what it can’t. There are some champions you cannot use your W against, such as Leona or Blitzcrank as their CC spells will put you closer to them. In the mid-game, stick with your allies at all times. Do not go to ward alone as Mel is extremely squishy and easy to kill if she is caught out of position.
champion.builds: THE BEST MEL BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Mel Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Coup de Grace and Presence of Mind in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Blackfire Torch. For your last 3 items, you should build Liandry's Torment, Shadowflame and finish with Rabadon's Deathcap. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 47.5% winrate over 18 431 matches played. Optional Your second option for Mel Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Dark Harvest as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Sixth Sense and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Scorch in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Blackfire Torch as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Liandry's Torment, Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 45.9% win rate over 1 327 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Coup de Grace with Presence of Mind in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Blackfire Torch as a third item. You want to finish the build with Liandry's Torment, Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 51.0% win rate across 764 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Mel Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight as your primary rune tree, and Gathering Storm with Manaflow Band as your secondary tree. Use Ability Haste, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Blackfire Torch as third item. The last 3 options are Liandry's Torment, Shadowflame and Rabadon's Deathcap. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 47.7% win rate over 476 matches played. Situational Mel Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Mel build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Mel runes page.
